name: Doctrine Feature
summary: Hold Doctrine Feature Hearthguard Your armour damage reduction applies to critical hits, but only for 1 damage. Ironhead Your attacks against machines, vehicles, and structures ignore resistance once per turn. Guild-Militant When an ally hits your Oath-Mark target, they may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.
